name: Recall
author: AlteringUX
description: A spaced-repetition memory trainer: short memory-technique lessons taught as fullscreen takeovers, then quizzed later on an adaptive, escalating cadence alongside a trivia deck. Engine + state owned by ~/.local/bin/omarchy-recall.

barWidget.description: Due-review counter that reddens with backlog; click for the deck panel. A daemon teaches a short technique lesson full-screen when one is ready, and raises quiz check-ins on an adaptive cadence that escalates to a takeover if you keep dismissing or a review goes badly stale.
